text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Teio! You were
amazing out
there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You've made a fan out of me today! I
can't wait
to see what you do next!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I won't let you down! Since this
win is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio points her index finger up in
the air.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This is just the first of my crowns! I'll
keep on
winning until I become a Triple
Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, at Tokai Teio's request,
we
continue training instead of taking a
break.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right. I'm gonna work my butt off! I
wanna do
that partner running thing
again.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fine! You worry too much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sides, I can't afford to slack off now.
What's my
next race, by the way?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! That race is every racer's
dream!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Which means every racer is gonna pull
out all the
stops to win.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I gotta give it everything I've got too!
Even
more than I did at the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, off to my partner run! That second
crown
better be sitting pretty for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without missing a beat, Tokai Teio
dashes off to
train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to rest. Our training for
the
Japanese Derby begins at once.
